stories.title: Madrid Prepares for Its First Robotaxi Services
stories.summary: The DGT authorised public-road tests for 20 autonomous vehicles operated by Uber, WeRide and AVOMO, moving Madrid closer to commercial robotaxi pilots. Projects involving the Ayuntamiento and the Comunidad de Madrid aim to begin commercial operations between late 2026 and 2027, provided they complete required technical and administrative procedures.

stories.title: Drone technology reaching new heights with the Welsh Ambulance Service and partners
stories.summary: The Welsh Ambulance Service and partners launched a project to showcase how medical drones can speed up care delivery. The proposed network aims to enable Beyond Visual Line of Sight operations, including a drone-based crossmatching service linking North Wales hospitals to the Welsh Blood Service HQ in Talbot Green.

stories.title: Utica Names Axon and Skydio for Drone Trial Flock Pitched in June
stories.summary: Utica, New York, is starting a 90-day Drone as First Responder trial for its police and fire departments, with two docked drones supplied through Axon and Skydio, the Utica Police Department said in a statement reported by the Observer-Dispatch on October 28. The drones would launch to 911 calls and fire scenes, often ahead of the officers or engines, the statement says.

stories.title: Pentagon's 60,000 Attack Drones Hit a 1940s Explosives Bottleneck
stories.summary: The Pentagon committed to buying 60,000 attack drones, but the U.S. lacks sufficient explosives to arm them because all HMX and RDX production comes from a single Tennessee plant. Solugen and Kraken Kinetics announced a joint venture called Odin Energetics with $115 million to start supplying small quantities next year, while the Army’s $1 billion plant modernization now targets 2029 or later.

stories.title: Trump Gives Robots Trade Talks After Drones Got Up to 100% Tariffs
stories.summary: President Donald Trump signed a Section 232 proclamation on October 28 that finds imports of robots, industrial machinery and their parts threaten U.S. national security, and then imposes no tariffs. The Commerce Secretary and the U.S. Trade Representative are told to negotiate agreements with trading partners instead.

stories.title: SkyDrive Welcomes U.S. Principal Officer Anna Wang to Advance Bilateral Cooperation on Commercial eVTOL Deployment
stories.summary: On Oct. 23, SkyDrive welcomed Anna Wang, principal officer of the U.S. Consulate Nagoya, to its Nagoya Airport office to discuss the commercialization of eVTOL aircraft and bilateral cooperation between Japan and the United States. Wang expressed support for facilitating coordination with relevant agencies to accelerate deployment and promoting business initiatives in the United States.

stories.title: FCC Nov. 19 Drone Vote Would Rewrite Two Single-Licensee Bands
Waymo Expands Driverless Ride Service Into South Bay
stories.summary: Waymo expanded its driverless ride-hailing service to Torrance, extending coverage through Manhattan Beach and Redondo Beach. The company said this Los Angeles expansion is part of a rollout adding nearly 250 square miles of coverage across five markets over the next week.

stories.title: Who Trains the Robots? What 1,196 Open Robot-Training Jobs Say About the Physical-AI Workforce
stories.summary: RobotTraining.jobs tracked 1,196 open robot-training postings from 99 employers as of October 28, 2026, with 525 roles for autonomous-vehicle and drone operators. The median hourly rate for the 274 postings stating pay is $25, while TSMG lists 503 postings across 49 countries.
